title: Nebula Cloud Workbench for Photogrammetry: 3D from Images

scenes.title: Nebula Cloud Workbench Overview
scenes.narration: The Nebula Cloud Workbench transforms multiple 2D images into precise 3D models and maps, leveraging the power of cloud computing for photogrammetry.

scenes.title: The Challenge of Local Photogrammetry
scenes.narration: Traditional photogrammetry demands immense local computing power and storage, often leading to slow processing times and significant hardware investment.

scenes.title: Seamless Image Upload to Cloud
scenes.narration: Users easily upload raw image datasets from various sources directly to Nebula's secure cloud storage, bypassing local transfer bottlenecks and hardware limits.

scenes.title: Scalable Cloud Processing Engine
scenes.narration: Nebula leverages distributed cloud resources, enabling massive parallel processing of image data for rapid and highly efficient 3D model reconstruction.

scenes.title: High-Fidelity 3D Model Generation
scenes.narration: The workbench generates diverse outputs like dense point clouds, textured 3D meshes, and high-resolution orthomosaics, ensuring data versatility for various needs.

scenes.title: Construction Progress Monitoring
scenes.narration: Construction firms use Nebula to regularly capture site images, generating accurate 3D models to monitor progress, track changes, and detect deviations over time.

scenes.title: Cultural Heritage Preservation
scenes.narration: Museums and archaeologists employ Nebula to create precise digital twins of historical sites and artifacts, enabling preservation, detailed study, and virtual access globally.

scenes.title: Mapping & Surveying Efficiency
scenes.narration: Surveyors and mappers utilize Nebula to process aerial imagery, rapidly generating highly accurate topographic maps and digital elevation models for diverse projects.

scenes.title: The Future: Cloud-Powered Photogrammetry
scenes.narration: Nebula Cloud Workbench democratizes photogrammetry, moving from restrictive local setups to a scalable, collaborative cloud environment accessible to everyone, everywhere.
